## Motivation

* Suppose we want to solve

$$
\frac{du}{dt} = f(u, t) + g(u, t) \\
$$

![`f+g` can be much more complicated than `f` and `g` individually](additive-split-of-fields.svg)

## Truncation errors

* The fundamental difficulty of Operator Splitting is truncation error
* Obvious methods have O(dt) error: Limited to Order 1
* To get high order solvers you need to build multistage meta-integrators.
